claim_1_covers: First filter = TANGENTIAL FLOW FILTER (explicitly claimed)
Returns filtered CSF (combined permeate) to CSF-containing space
us12364952b2_exact_claims.key_limitation: Claim 1 explicitly recites: 'wherein the first filter includes a tangential flow filter for filtering the first volume of the fluid into a first permeate and a first retentate'
us12364952b2_exact_claims.flow_rate_range: Claim 7: first flow rate between approximately 0.04 mL/min and 30 mL/min — this OVERLAPS with CSF production rate (0.2-0.7 mL/min)

c04_tangential_flow_vs_us12364952_mappin.c04_tangential_flow_element: Tangential flow filtration for CSF to prevent RBC accumulation
c04_tangential_flow_vs_us12364952_mappin.us12364952_claim_1: Explicitly claims 'tangential flow filter' for CSF filtration
c04_tangential_flow_vs_us12364952_mappin.verdict: TANGENTIAL FLOW FOR CSF IS DIRECTLY ANTICIPATED BY US12,364,952B2 CLAIM 1. The proposed escape mechanism is NOT novel.

differentiators: Passive (no pump — US12,364,952 uses a pump)
c04_remaining_differentiators_after_tang.ceo_directive_on_these: Do not call it novel simply because the patented system is externally pumped rather than implanted.
c04_remaining_differentiators_after_tang.analysis: The differentiators (implantable, passive, no pump, eShunt geometry) are ENGINEERING ADAPTATIONS, not new causal mechanisms. Making an external pumped tangential-flow CSF filter into an implantable passive one is an obvious engineering challenge, not a patentable mechanism difference. The causal mechanism (tangential flow filtration of CSF) is the SAME.
c04_remaining_differentiators_after_tang.section_103_threat: HIGH — US12,364,952 (tangential flow CSF) + eShunt patents (implantable venous sinus) + PHH literature → obvious to combine into an implantable passive tangential-flow CSF shunt for PHH

C04_KILL_DECISION.question: If no genuinely differentiated causal mechanism remains, kill C04.
C04_KILL_DECISION.answer: NO genuinely differentiated causal mechanism remains.
reasoning: Original mechanism (filter + bypass + pressure valve): §102 anticipated by US4741730A
Escape mechanism 1 (tangential flow): §102 anticipated by US12,364,952B2
Remaining differentiators (implantable, passive, no pump, eShunt geometry, PHH, neonatal): engineering adaptations, not new causal mechanisms
Graveyard investigation: US4741730A likely failed because sustained blood burden clogs ANY dead-end filter. Tangential flow solves this, but tangential flow for CSF is already patented.

No third mechanism proposed that avoids both US4741730A (dead-end filter) and US12,364,952 (tangential flow). Centrifugal/acoustic/electromagnetic separation were mentioned but are physically implausible at CSF flow rates in an implantable device.
C04_KILL_DECISION.verdict: KILLED — C04 does not survive the destruction attack. The core architecture is occupied (US4741730A). The proposed escape mechanism is occupied (US12,364,952). The remaining differentiators are engineering adaptations, not patentable mechanism differences.
C04_KILL_DECISION.anti_resurrection_rule: Per CEO directive: 'When the escape route gets killed, don't immediately invent another escape route.' I will NOT propose a third escape mechanism (centrifugal, acoustic, etc.) to keep C04 alive. Those mechanisms are physically implausible at CSF flow rates in an implantable device, and inventing them just to preserve the candidate would violate the pushing-the-envelope principle.

us20110262442a1_exact_claims_and_status.inventor: Charles P. Hamilton, Nathan Dean Jorgensen
us20110262442a1_exact_claims_and_status.claim_1: A method for delivering a small molecule therapeutic agent to the brain, comprising: (a) an agent which ACTIVATES BOTH A1 and A2a adenosine receptors [AGONIST]; and (b) a small molecule therapeutic agent.
us20110262442a1_exact_claims_and_status.key_finding: The claims cover AGONISTS (activators) of A1+A2a receptors for BBB PERMEABILITY enhancement — NOT ANTAGONISTS for CSF production reduction.
us20110262442a1_exact_claims_and_status.mechanism_difference: US20110262442A1 uses A2a AGONISTS to OPEN the BBB for drug delivery. C09 uses A2a ANTAGONISTS to REDUCE CSF production. These are OPPOSITE pharmacological directions (activate vs block) for DIFFERENT purposes (BBB opening vs CSF secretion reduction).

c09_vs_us20110262442_mapping.c09_mechanism: A2A ANTAGONIST delivered via eShunt into CSF to reduce choroid plexus CSF secretion
c09_vs_us20110262442_mapping.us20110262442_mechanism: A2A AGONIST (with A1 agonist) to enhance BBB permeability for small molecule drug delivery to brain
c09_vs_us20110262442_mapping.shared_element: Both involve A2A adenosine receptors and the choroid plexus / BBB
different_elements: C09: reduces CSF production; US20110262442: opens BBB for drug delivery
C09: delivered via eShunt into CSF; US20110262442: administered systemically (method of delivering to subject)
C09: for hydrocephalus/CSF overproduction; US20110262442: for CNS drug delivery broadly
c09_vs_us20110262442_mapping.section_102_verdict: NOT ANTICIPATED — US20110262442A1 does NOT teach A2A antagonists for CSF reduction. It teaches A2A agonists for BBB opening. These are different pharmacological mechanisms.
c09_vs_us20110262442_mapping.section_103_verdict: WEAK — would require combining US20110262442 (A2A receptor involvement in ChP/BBB) + Zheng 2025 (A2A antagonism reduces CSF) + eShunt patents. But US20110262442 is ABANDONED, reducing its weight as prior art. Zheng 2025 is scientific literature (not a patent). The combination motivation is moderate, not strong.
c09_vs_us20110262442_mapping.corrected_verdict: US20110262442A1 is RELEVANT DISCLOSURE but NOT ANTICIPATION of C09. The CEO's correction is right: 'relevant disclosure ≠ anticipation.'

c09_remaining_challenges.challenge_1_physics: Drug must reach choroid plexus from CSF side, which is UPSTREAM in CSF flow. CSF flows FROM choroid plexus TO venous sinus. Delivering A2A antagonist via eShunt (at the venous sinus) would deliver it DOWNSTREAM of the choroid plexus. The drug would need to flow retrograde to reach the ChP. This is a PHYSICS OBSTACLE that may make the mechanism infeasible.
c09_remaining_challenges.challenge_2_slot_3_overlap: Drug delivery via eShunt overlaps with Slot 3 (Controlled CNS Therapeutic Platform). C09 risks being a Slot 3 extension, not a new invention.
c09_remaining_challenges.challenge_3_patent_landscape_beyond_us20: Zheng 2025 (A2AR → CSF secretion) is likely patent-active. Need to search whether the researchers/institutions filed patents on A2A antagonism for hydrocephalus specifically.
c09_remaining_challenges.challenge_4_clinical_precedent: CPC (choroid plexus coagulation) is established. Acetazolamide is available. A2A antagonism would need to beat these on reversibility/controllability.

C09_SURVIVE_DECISION.question: Does C09 survive the destruction attack?
C09_SURVIVE_DECISION.answer: CONDITIONALLY SURVIVES — but with significant unresolved challenges.
reasoning: US20110262442A1 is NOT §102 anticipation (agonist vs antagonist, BBB opening vs CSF reduction). Corrected.
US20110262442A1 is ABANDONED, reducing its weight as §103 prior art.
§103 from US20110262442 + Zheng 2025 + eShunt is WEAK (abandoned + scientific literature + different device).
BUT: the retrograde delivery physics obstacle is SIGNIFICANT. If drug cannot reach choroid plexus from the eShunt location, the mechanism is infeasible regardless of patent status.
AND: the Slot 3 overlap risk remains.
AND: Zheng 2025's institution may have filed patents not yet found.
C09_SURVIVE_DECISION.verdict: C09 SURVIVES the patent gate (§102 not established, §103 weak) but faces a SIGNIFICANT PHYSICS OBSTACLE (retrograde delivery) and a SLOT 3 OVERLAP risk. C09 is NOT promoted — it is CONDITIONAL, pending physics pre-check and Slot 3 distinction.
C09_SURVIVE_DECISION.next_action: If the CEO directs: (1) search for Zheng 2025 institution patents on A2A antagonism for hydrocephalus, (2) physics pre-check on retrograde CSF drug delivery, (3) Slot 3 distinction analysis. But do NOT invest in a simulator until these are resolved.

FINAL_SLOT5_DECISION.C04: KILLED — core architecture occupied (US4741730A), escape mechanism occupied (US12,364,952), remaining differentiators are engineering adaptations. No genuinely differentiated causal mechanism remains. Anti-resurrection rule applied: no third escape mechanism invented.
FINAL_SLOT5_DECISION.C09: CONDITIONAL — survives patent gate (US20110262442 is abandoned + different mechanism) but faces physics obstacle (retrograde delivery) and Slot 3 overlap. NOT promoted.

LESSON_LEARNED.pattern_observed: candidate → proposed escape mechanism → escape mechanism itself has prior art
LESSON_LEARNED.ceo_insight: This is not a failure of the discovery engine. It is exactly what a serious destruction stage should expose.
LESSON_LEARNED.constitutional_implication: The destruction engine must keep attacking proposed escape mechanisms too. An escape mechanism is not a safe harbor — it is a new candidate that must survive its own destruction attack.
LESSON_LEARNED.anti_resurrection_principle: When the escape route gets killed, don't immediately invent another escape route. First ask whether the original candidate deserves to survive at all. This prevents infinite candidate resurrection.
LESSON_LEARNED.bound_to_constitution: This principle is now operationally enforced in the Slot 5 discovery process. Future escape mechanisms will be attacked before being accepted as survival paths.

provenance.constitution_acknowledgment: Articles I, II, VI, VII, XX, XXVII, XXVIII, XXIX, XXXII, XXXV applied. Anti-resurrection principle enforced. No third escape mechanism invented for C04.
